provenance.method: Read-only PE section mapping, exact 72-record native mode table, pointed-to ASCII keys and matching extracted Chinese localization. Mode 0 and runtime field semantics come from native control flow.
provenance.caution: Catalog membership, localization and ID mapping are verified statically. No mode is declared unlocked or tested for direct start by this catalog.

native_table.page_note: Page values and coordinates are native raw table data; category labels follow the associated localization keys.

app_layout.status_note: These are App fields and remain readable when no Board exists, provided the verified process and root pointer remain valid.
evidence: menu native analysis: 45c4a0 creates main menu, 45c5d0 award, 45c740 scene6 widget, 45c840 challenge screen

fields.verification: 416d3d reads and 416d40 copies to Board+5568 for mode0
mechanics-code/0x43c070.c updates and clamps to 99999; units depend on native coin value
native menu analysis; existing 4205d0 uses <1 as first-play tutorial condition
461510 reads this DWORD. Modes1..5 require>=5, modes6..10 require>=10, endless11..15/60/70 returnfalse, other IDs require>0. This is completion, not unlock status.
439c8f tests this byte; nonzero causes439c20 to return0 regardless of its earlier calculated lock amount. Read-only metadata; not a suggested profile modification.

profile_layout.unlocks_note: Completion count and campaign progress can inform eligibility but are not a complete native unlock predicate. Per-mode availability remains unknown until native profile/menu checks are queried. Do not rewrite profile fields to implement a temporary level selection.

challenge_lock_amount.calling_convention: EDI=ChallengeScreen, EAX=native table index (mode_id-1); return EAX
challenge_lock_amount.semantics: 0 means no challenge lock deficit; positive values are lock/progression deficits. Requires a valid ChallengeScreen and profile; not invoked or validated by the static catalog.

mode_completed.semantics: Uses profile completion records and mode-specific thresholds; endless modes11..15/60/70 always returnfalse.
